name: Blue Dream
summary: **Blue Dream** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] that emerged around 2003 in Santa Cruz, California, as a clone-only cross of [[blueberry|Blueberry]] and a [[haze|Haze]] phenotype. Sources differ on whether that second parent was [[super-silver-haze|Super Silver Haze]] or a local Santa Cruz Haze cut. No single breeder has been identified; the cut spread through Santa Cruz growers before seed versions followed.

sources.title: Blue Dream Strain Review: The Santa Cruz Cut, Genetics & Grow Guide
